reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 15 --verse 1.115.1: the evidence words stand verbatim in Sāyaṇa’s commentary on 1.115.1: the Sūrya within the orb, the supreme Self who impels all as inner controller (antaryāmitayā sarvasya prerakaḥ paramātmā), is the self of moving and stationary, for he is the cause of all effects and the effect is not other than the cause (kāraṇāc ca kāryaṃ nātiricyate). The sentence carries exactly that; ‘first’ honestly marks his yadvā alternative (the life-soul of all beings, reviving the world at sunrise). He supports it by the Brahmasūtra 2.1.14, but the roster gives Sāyaṇa no school and the sentence names none, which the rules do not require here. Wilson note b reports the cause clause. Plain sense against day.js: 1.115 opens on the rising and closes the course with the horses loosed and Night spreading (1.115.4); no four words of the key. verse.js ok (Rig Veda 1.115.1, at [114,1]); entry-check ok. No comparison or tone issue.
